But he's missing something important when it comes to big publishers. They don't care about games, they don't care about gamers, they don't care about anything except money. They figure out what the largest potential market and title is - and they make it. This the reason all games are merging into becoming shooters and stabbers. Shooters and stabbers sell the best and have the largest perceived audience - so everything starts becoming a shooter or stabber.

The post soviet games were amazing. 1C and Akella were both founded just at this time and ended up with a ridiculous number of classics. However, these games were also primarily made by people who wanted to make a game because they thought it was a fun or interesting idea - not because they thought it'd be most likely to make them lots of money.

Telling big publishers in America to focus on new audiences is akin to telling them to focus on actually making games instead of making money - and that's something entirely foreign to them.

My mum's computer is right next to the router but it has trouble loading youtube videos. Can anyone help?

You can try a different network cable if it is wired.

A different wireless channel if it is wireless.

You can try a different port in the router if it is wired and has more than one.

You can try checking her processes to see if her web browser is wigging out over youtube and you need to try another browser.

You can check network behaviour to see if she is producing enough traffic to interfere, say, a few viruses, worms, or it may be a member of a zombie bot network.

You can check to see if she has some other process running that is using up a lot of CPU time or RAM and kill them.

That'd be the first things I look for.
And? You can do all those things on a Mac still.
